question: Where should the māyā seed and the Manmatha element be placed on the hexagon?
premises: The māyā bīja is placed on the sides of the hexagon
The Manmatha element is placed at the tip
inference: The hexagon receives the māyā seed on its sides and Manmatha at its point
uncertainties: Whether manmatham refers to the kāma bīja or the name is not explicit
plain_english: On the sides of the hexagon place the māyā seed, and at the tip place Manmatha.
